subject: Validate slot import ranges when loading from RDB (#4229)
reason: This is a defensive guard against corrupt/crafted RDB input: clusterRDBLoadSlotImport now rejects slot-import ranges with start_slot or end_slot >= CLUSTER_SLOTS or start > end, and the kvstore asserts now bound-check didx>=0. It is a real crash fix (the parent aborts on assert, or reads out of bounds, in kvstoreSetIsImporting), but it is unreachable by the fuzzer's vehicles with a valid verdict. A bad range can only come from crafted RDB bytes: no legitimate Valkey save emits one (save ranges come from command parsing or a now-validated load), so every forkless-save, rdb-compression, snapshot
